4823-5744-7507-8043.easyPrerequisites: You haven't cast a spell for free using Vision this turn.
4823-5744-7507-8043.description:
Cast Kindred Charge for free due to Vision, choosing a creature type granted by Roshan, creating a token copy of each creature you control with haste, and setting up a delayed exile trigger.
Put the copy of Vision whose ability has been used in your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When the Timeless Witness token enters, it triggers, returning Kindred Charge from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

339-677-1879-8250.description:
Activate Jegantha by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} that cannot be spent to pay generic mana costs.
Activate Scarland Thrinax by sacrificing Jegantha, putting a +1/+1 counter on Scarland Thrinax
Activate Horde of Notions by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, causing you to cast Jegantha from your graveyard without paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

1742-1978-3363-5793.notablePrerequisites: The One Ring has a burden counter on it.
1742-1978-3363-5793.description:
Activate The One Ring by tapping it, putting a burden counter on it and drawing a card for each burden counter on it.
Activate Skirge Familiar twice by discarding two cards, adding {B}{B}.
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping The One Ring.
Repeat

3525-5268-7937.description:
Activate Badgey by tapping it, adding {U}.
Badgey triggers, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life
Activate Pemmin's Aura by paying {U}, untapping Badgey.
Repeat.

215-1355-6965.notablePrerequisites: You control at least four enchantments.
215-1355-6965.description:
Activate Sanctum Weaver by tapping it, adding an amount of {G}.
Activate Temur Sabertooth by paying {1}{G}, returning Sanctum Weaver from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Sanctum Weaver by paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

670-1619-3991-6140.notablePrerequisites: You are currently venturing in Tomb of Annihilation in the Trapped Entry room.
670-1619-3991-6140.description:
Cast Faceless Butcher by paying its mana cost.
When Faceless Butcher enters, it and Radiant Solar trigger.
Resolve the Faceless Butcher trigger, exiling Cloister Gargoyle.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger, venturing into the Oubliette room, causing you to discard a card and then sacrifice Faceless Butcher.
When Faceless Butcher dies, it triggers, returning Cloister Gargoyle from exile to the battlefield.
When Cloister Gargoyle enters, it and Radiant Solar trigger.
Resolve the Cloister Gargoyle trigger, venturing into the Cradle of the Death God room, creating a 4/4 legendary The Atropal creature token and completing Tomb of Annihilation.
If you control two or more The Atropal tokens, put all but one into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Sefris' second ability triggers, returning Faceless Butcher from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Faceless Butcher enters, it and Radiant Solar trigger.
Resolve the Faceless Butcher trigger, exiling Cloister Gargoyle.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger from step 10, venturing into Tomb of Annihilation and into the Trapped Entry room, causing each player to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger from step 6, venturing into the Oubliette room, causing you to discard a card and then sacrifice Faceless Butcher.
Repeat from step 5.

3887-4050-7496.easyPrerequisites: You control at least four creatures.
3887-4050-7496.description:
Cast Lab Rats with buyback by paying {B} due to its affinity for creatures, creating a creature token and returning Lab Rats to your hand.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the creature token, adding {B}.
Repeat.

4050-5086-5183-6441-6996.easyPrerequisites: Triskelavus has two or more +1/+1 counters on it.
4050-5086-5183-6441-6996.description:
Activate Triskelavus by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, creating two creature tokens.
Activate a Triskelavite token by sacrificing it, dealing 1 damage to any target and causing you to gain life.
The Destined White Mage triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Triskelavus
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing another creature token, adding one mana of any color.
Repeat from step 1.

uses.exileCardState: with three or fewer time counters on it

1618-2440-2654-3992.notablePrerequisites: You control at least six creatures that share a creature type with the tokens generated by Shark Typhoon
1618-2440-2654-3992.description:
Activate The Tenth Doctor by paying {7}, removing all time counters from Cyclical Evolution.
Cyclical Evolution triggers, causing you to cast it from exile without paying its mana cost.
Shark Typhoon triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters, Mana Echoes triggers, adding {C} for each creature you control that shares a creature type with the token.
Resolve Cyclical Evolution.
Repeat.
1618-2440-2654-3992.notes: You may start the combo controlling fewer that six creatures that share a type with the tokens generated by Shark Typhoon. If you do, you need to provide an appropriate amount of mana until Mana Echoes will start generating seven {C} or more.

323-2921-4681-5170.description:
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Karmic Guide.
When Karmic Guide dies, Falkenrath Noble triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Junji.
When Junji dies, it and Falkenrath Noble trigger.
Resolve the Falkenrath Noble trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Junji trigger, returning Karmic Guide from your graveyard to the battlefield and causing you to lose 2 life.
When Karmic Guide enters, it triggers, returning Junji from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Repeat.

862-2173-2438-5220.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Crimson Kobolds
When Crimson Kobolds dies, Mortuary triggers, putting Crimson Kobolds from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Cast Crimson Kobolds from the top of your library by paying 0 life.
Repeat.

3197-5686-6872.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to put a +1/+1 counter on Herd Baloth
3197-5686-6872.description:
Put a +1/+1 counter on Herd Baloth
Herd Baloth triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Long Feng triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Herd Baloth.
Herd Baloth triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Repeat from step 3.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to Siren of the Silent Song

1557-3525-6006.description:
Activate Siren of the Silent Song by tapping it, adding {U}.
Activate Pemmin's Aura by paying {U}, untapping Siren of the Silent Song.
Siren of the Silent Song triggers, causing each opponent to discard a card and mill a card.
Repeat.

4052-4186-6822.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to draw a card.
4052-4186-6822.description:
Draw a card.
Lyla triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Scurry Oak.
Scurry Oak triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters, Kindred Discovery triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Repeat from step 2.

719-3000-4508-5880.description:
Activate Magmaw by paying {1} and sacrificing another nonland permanent, dealing 1 damage to an opponent.
Malcolm triggers, creating a 1/1 Squirrel creature token and a Treasure token.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

575-2348-5256.notablePrerequisites: You control an additional nontoken creature.
575-2348-5256.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing another nontoken creature.
When the creature dies, Yedora triggers, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield face down as a Forest land and as a 2/2 creature due to Nature's Revolt.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability, causing target player to mill cards equal to the creature's power.
Repeat.

1029-2033-4007.notablePrerequisites: Reckless Racer does not have summoning sickness.
1029-2033-4007.description:
Activate Reckless Racer by tapping it, adding {G}.
Reckless Racer triggers, causing you to rummage.
Tolarian Kraken triggers, causing you to pay {1} to untap Reckless Racer.
Repeat.

1752-4116-5168.notablePrerequisites:
Locust Swarm and Bloom Tender have at least one counter on them.
You control a red and/or white permanent.
Volrath does not have summoning sickness.
1752-4116-5168.description:
Activate Volrath by paying {1}, causing it to become a copy of Bloom Tender until your next turn.
Activate Volrath by tapping it, adding at least {W}{U}{B}{G}.
Activate Volrath by paying {1}, causing it to become a copy of Locust Swarm until your next turn.
Activate Volrath by paying {G}, untapping it.
Repeat.

713-1429-2034.notablePrerequisites: Lesser Masticore does not have a -1/-1 counter on it.
713-1429-2034.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Lesser Masticore, adding one mana of any color.
When Lesser Masticore dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Lesser Masticore enters the battlefield, Surrak and Goreclaw triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Lesser Masticore and giving it haste until end of turn.
Repeat.

2390-4179-5299.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to put a counter on a permanent or player.
2390-4179-5299.description:
Cast Triumph of the Hordes by paying {2}{G}{G}, giving creatures you control +1/+1 and infect until end of turn.
Put a counter on a permanent or player.
All Will Be One triggers, giving an opponent a poison counter.
Repeat step 3.

uses.n: Birgi, God of Storytelling // Harnfel, Horn of Bounty

392-1283-1858-4280.description:
Cast View from Above by paying {2}, targeting Birgi.
Birgi and Veyran trigger twice.
Resolve the Birgi triggers, adding {2}.
Resolve the Veyran triggers, giving it +2/+2 until end of turn.
Resolve View from Above, giving Birgi flying until end of turn and returning View from Above to your hand.
Repeat.

628-793-1380-1636-2838.notablePrerequisites: Soul Diviner does not have summoning sickness.
628-793-1380-1636-2838.description:
Activate Scorched Rusalka by paying {R} and sacrificing Jewel-Eyed Cobra.
Jewel-Eyed Cobra triggers, creating a treasure token.
Resolve the Jewel-Eyed Cobra's undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Intruder Alarm triggers, untapping all creatures.
Resolve the Sorched Rusalka trigger, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Activate the treasure token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {R}.
Activate Soul Diviner by tapping it, removing a +1/+1 counter from Jewel-Eyed Cobra.
Repeat.

430-2567-2743.notablePrerequisites:
You have not created any tokens this turn.
You control at least three lands.
430-2567-2743.description:
Cast Avenger of Zendikar by paying {5}{G}{G}.
Avenger of Zendikar enters the battlefield, creating at least three token copies of Biovisionary due to Esix.
At the beginning of your end step, each Biovisionary triggers.
Resolve the first Biovisionary trigger, causing you to win the game.

uses.n: Vito, Thorn of the Dusk Rose

314-1545-4658.notablePrerequisites: Your life total is higher than or equal to an opponent's.
314-1545-4658.description:
Cast Soul of Eternity by paying {5}{W}{W}.
Soul of Eternity enters the battlefield, triggering Trostani, causing you to gain life equal to Soul of Eternity's toughness.
Vito triggers, causing target opponent whose lifetotal is less than or equal to Soul of Eternity's toughness to lose life equal to the life you gained.
The opponent loses the game due to having zero or less life.

4112-4284.description:
Cast Clone by paying {3}{U}.
Clone enters as a copy of Sharuum.
Put Sharuum into the graveyard due to the legend rule.
Clone triggers, returning Sharuum from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Put Sharuum into the graveyard due to the legend rule.
Sharuum enters the battlefield triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 5.
